audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Kayle four stages including level 3 and first item, which the prose calls Ambessa's outright: whys[2] says 'Your full short combo is online — dash-weave... before she can steroid-kite you', and whys[5] plus spikes[2] say 'force every all-in here'. mid opens with 'This is your window'.
audit.why: Against a scaling champion the chart should show a clean handover, not a scatter. Ambessa owns 1, 3, 6 and first item; Kayle owns the 4-5 farming gap and everything from two items.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Ambessa / Skill / Ambessa / Kayle / Ambessa / Ambessa / Kayle in both layers — Ambessa 4, Kayle 2, Skill 1, matching 51.05% and reading as the race the page describes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment is the axis of the whole page — 'bait it, then ult' appears four times — and its cooldown is never given once.
audit.why: It is 160/120/80 seconds. At rank 1 that is longer than an entire lane phase, and longer than Ambessa's own 130-second ultimate, which completely changes the value of baiting it: forcing Kayle to spend Divine Judgment at level 6 buys you almost three minutes of a Kayle with no escape. Without the number, 'bait it first' reads as a small tempo note instead of the plan.
audit.corrected: 160/120/80s stated in mid, whys[4], spikes[1].text, wants.you[1], breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two of Kayle's abilities are never named and the third is described as the wrong thing. The page says 'her E attack-speed steroid and auto-resets out-poke you'. Starfire Spellblade is not an attack-speed steroid — Riot's text is a passive that adds bonus magic damage to her attacks plus an active whose bonus damage scales with the target's MISSING HEALTH. The attack speed belongs to Divine Ascent. Radiant Blast and Celestial Blessing are absent from the page entirely.
audit.why: Both missing abilities matter more than the one that is there. Radiant Blast is a 900-range piercing sword that slows and REDUCES THE RESISTANCES of everyone it hits — against a champion whose damage is entirely physical and who wants to stack armour, that shred is the reason her trades scale better than yours. Celestial Blessing is a flat 15-second heal on herself and the nearest ally, which is exactly the sustain that undoes Ambessa's won short trades. And the missing-health scaling on Starfire Spellblade means her damage is largest at precisely the moment you are trying to disengage.
audit.corrected: Radiant Blast named with its 900 range, 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown and resistance shred in whys[3], whys[6], late, spikes[3].text, wants.foe[0] and report[5].t. Celestial Blessing named with its 15s heal. The E mislabel corrected to Divine Ascent's attack speed plus a Starfire Spellblade auto reset.

audit.why: Trade on your Medarda Maxim stack, leave when energy is spent, all-in at 3 and at first item — the shape is right for a melee-versus-melee phase against a champion who becomes ranged. Kept, with the ability attributions fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never mentions Grievous Wounds, though the full layer's own late-game line says 'anti-heal stays core' — the two layers disagree.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing heals Kayle on a flat 15-second cooldown regardless of rank, and she is a scaling champion who only needs to survive. Anti-heal is what makes a won level 3 trade actually cost her something.
audit.corrected: Named in mid, whys[5], spikes[2].text and wants.you[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Ascent is treated as a binary 'ranged form at 11' rather than what Riot describes.
audit.why: Riot's text: her attacks are empowered 'as she levels up and spends skill points', progressively gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range and waves of fire. It is a ramp, not a switch — which means the lane gets worse for Ambessa every few levels rather than at one cliff, and the urgency is continuous.
audit.corrected: Reworded in whys[2], spikes[0].text and early to describe the ramp. I left the 'ranged form at 11' line in wants.foe[1] untouched on the level number itself, since Riot's text does not name a level.

edits.before: Kayle has no ranged form and is one of the weakest level-1s in the game, but so are you — one ability, no Sundering Slam follow-up yet, and you're energy-gated, so don't throw a lone Cunning Sweep expecting to win the opening. Farm with the outer edge of the Q cone for the doubled damage and wait for Level 3, when Cunning Sweep into Sundering Slam plus the Lacerate slow lets you dash-weave an empowered auto onto a melee Kayle who can't kite you yet. Trade when your Medarda Maxim stack is up, then walk out the instant your energy is spent — her E attack-speed steroid and auto-resets out-poke you if you stand and brawl.
edits.after: Kayle has no ranged form and is one of the weakest level-1s in the game, but so are you — one ability, no Sundering Slam follow-up yet, and you're energy-gated, so don't throw a lone Cunning Sweep expecting to win the opening. edits.before: This is your window, and it's a race against her scaling. At 6 Public Execution blinks you behind her, suppresses and crashes her for the stun — her only escape is Divine Judgment invulnerability, so don't waste R into it; force her to burn Judgment in a Q/E trade first, then ult the moment it drops. Through Levels 4-5 your ability cooldowns are at their longest and she's farming toward her spike, so don't whiff a combo and concede the wave. By First item, with Eclipse and your Level 9 Q max, Cunning Sweep into an empowered auto into Sundering Slam halves her health while she's still got no ranged auto and thin waveclear — every kill now is one she can't get back, because once she hits two items the lane tilts to her.
edits.after: This is your window, and it's a race against her scaling. At 6 Public Execution blinks 1250 units, suppresses and crashes her for the stun — her only escape is Divine Judgment, and that is 160 seconds at rank 1, so force her to spend it in a Radiant Blast trade first, then ult the moment it drops. Through Levels 4-5 your cooldowns are at their longest and she's farming toward her spike, so don't whiff a combo and concede the wave. By First item, with Eclipse and your Level 9 Q max, Cunning Sweep into an empowered auto into Sundering Slam halves her health while she's still melee — and keep Grievous Wounds on her, because Celestial Blessing heals every 15 seconds.

edits.before: You lose the late game, full stop. At 2+ items Kayle's ranged form lets her kite your dash chains from outside empowered-auto range, her on-hit DPS shreds you, and Divine Judgment turns every all-in into a five-second wait where she just walks away. Your whole kit is physical, so her tempo plus any single defensive item blunts you while you can't blunt her invuln. Win this lane before her two-item spike — deny her CS, crack her tower, and snowball your early leads into objectives before her scaling ever comes online. If it goes long, never duel her one-for-one; only commit when Divine Judgment is on cooldown.
edits.after: You lose the late game, full stop. At 2+ items Kayle's ranged form lets her kite your dash chains from outside empowered-auto range, her on-hit damage shreds you, and Divine Judgment turns every all-in into a wait where she simply walks away. Radiant Blast also reduces the resistances of everyone it pierces, so your armour buys less than it should while your own damage stays entirely physical. Win this lane before her two-item spike — deny her CS, crack her tower, and convert early leads into objectives. If it goes long, only commit while Divine Judgment is on cooldown.

notes: Two of Kayle's five abilities — Radiant Blast and Celestial Blessing — appeared nowhere on the page, and the one ability that was described was described wrongly: 'her E attack-speed steroid' conflates Starfire Spellblade (a spellblade whose active scales with the target's missing health) with Divine Ascent (the passive that actually grants attack speed, move speed and range). The most useful thing recovered is Radiant Blast reducing the resistances of everyone it hits, which is directly hostile to an armour-stacking, physical-damage Ambessa and had no mention anywhere. Divine Judgment's 160/120/80 cooldown was also missing despite 'bait it first' being the page's central instruction — at rank 1 that bait buys nearly three minutes. I did not touch the 'ranged form at 11' claim in the enemy-wants list beyond removing it from one line: Riot's text describes Divine Ascent as a progressive ramp with levels and skill points and names no threshold level, so I could not verify 11 from the kits and did not want to assert or contradict it.
